<jats:title>A<jats:sc>bstract</jats:sc>
                     </jats:title><jats:p>We study the O(2<jats:italic>N</jats:italic>) model at criticality in three dimensions in the double scaling limit of large <jats:italic>N</jats:italic> and large charge. We show that the large-charge expansion is an asymptotic series, and we use resurgence techniques to study the non-perturbative corrections and to extend the validity of the <jats:sc>eft</jats:sc> to any value of the charge. We conjecture the general form of the non-perturbative behavior of the conformal dimensions for any value of <jats:italic>N</jats:italic> and find very good agreement with previous lattice data.</jats:p>
title: Resurgence of the large-charge expansion
